description: This file defines the 'ResourceHandler' interface which provides methods for accessing resource data such as loading documents, streams, URLs, and resource location information within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ResourceHandler
classes.description: An interface that provides methods for resource management, including loading documents, streams, and retrieving resource metadata.

methods.name: getLoaderName
methods.description: Returns the name of the loader used to load the resource.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Returns the location string of the resource.

methods.name: getDocument
methods.description: Loads and returns the resource as an XML Document.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Provides an InputStream to read the resource data.

methods.name: getURL
methods.description: Returns the URL of the resource.

methods.name: isFileResource
methods.description: Indicates whether the resource is a file-based resource.

methods.name: getFullLocation
methods.description: Returns the full location string including any additional path or details.
